parameters.name: CredentialConfig
parameters.description:
**If you have no special requirements, leave this parameter empty.**

The chained authorization configuration. For more information, see [Use chained authorization to access resources of other entities](~~465340~~).

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The message notification configuration. For more information, click Notification. For the format of asynchronous notification messages, see [Asynchronous notification message format](~~2743997~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the project. For more information, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description: A list of input images. The images are converted in the order of their URIs in this list.

sub_parameters.name: Rotate
sub_parameters.description:
The rotation angle of the image in degrees. Valid values:

- 0 (default)

- 90

- 180

- 270

sub_parameters.name: URI
sub_parameters.description:
The OSS address of the source image.

The address must be in the \`oss\://${Bucket}/${Object}\` format. \``${Bucket}`\` must be an OSS bucket in the same region as the project. \``${Object}`\` must be the full path of the file, including its file name extension.

Supported formats: JPG, JP2, PNG, TIFF, WebP, BMP, and SVG.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: Custom tags used to search for and filter asynchronous tasks.

parameters.name: TargetURI
parameters.description:
The OSS address where the output PDF file is stored.

The address must be in the \`oss\://${bucketname}/${objectname}\` format. \`${bucketname}\` must be an OSS bucket in the same region as the project. \`${objectname}\` must be the path of the file, including the file name.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: Custom user information that is returned in the asynchronous notification message. This helps you associate the notification message with your system. The maximum length is 2048 bytes.
